title: Asymptotic Fermat Fourfold Hodge Induction for All Moduli m -> Infinity: Prime-Power Galois Defect Bounds and Arithmetic Progression Coordinate Exclusion
description: Formal machine-verified Lean 4 proof and numerical probes establishing the algebraicity of rational Hodge classes on Fermat fourfolds for all moduli m -> infinity via prime-power Galois defect bounds and AP exclusion in dimension 6. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
